title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Enrollment and Tier Assignment
content:
A CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan is enrolled only for a customer whose Commercial Credit Account status is active. The tier is the one requested when the customer registers at least its minimum number of instruments, otherwise the highest tier met; the first plan year starts on activation and lasts the tier's plan year length in months, and the plan fee, at the tier's annual plan fee, is billed under the tier's plan fee billing.

## 1. Credit standing at enrollment

- The condition is read from the company's record of the customer's Commercial Credit Account: the account belonging to the same customer as the plan, and the status that account shows. The customer's own description of its account does not substitute for that record.
- The condition is tested before the plan is enrolled.
- Only the status active satisfies it.

## 2. Tier assignment

Each tier has a minimum number of registered instruments:

| Tier | Minimum registered instruments |
|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | 1 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 10 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | 25 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 50 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 150 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | 400 |

The requested tier is assigned when the customer registers at least that tier's minimum. When the customer registers fewer, the tier assigned is the highest tier whose minimum the registered count meets.

| Requested tier (hypothetical) | Instruments registered (hypothetical) | Tier assigned |
|---|---|---|
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 50 | CalCare Accredited Plan (minimum met exactly) |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 49 | CalCare Standard Plan (highest minimum met is 25) |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 100 | CalCare Accredited Plan (highest minimum met is 50) |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 9 | CalCare Pay-Per-Service (highest minimum met is 1) |

## 3. Start of the plan

- A newly enrolled plan is pending. The plan year starts once the plan fee (if any) is billed and the instrument registry is loaded; that is the activation of the plan, and the first plan year starts on activation.
- The first plan year lasts the tier's plan year length in months, and the plan fee is the tier's annual plan fee, billed under the tier's plan fee billing setting.
- Before the plan starts, the customer may cancel it; the plan then moves from pending to cancelled.
